evals.prompt: Génère le handoff développeur complet du composant Input depuis https://www.figma.com/design/<fileKey>/Foundations?node-id=729-14491 , format Notion, en français.
evals.expected_output: A French Notion-ready handoff with provenance, anatomy (Input > base.input-style > base.input-content), sizes, states with Read-only flagged as missing, token table from variables, hardcoded radius/padding/gap values, accessibility annotations including Grey/400 contrast 2.54:1 and target size for small sizes, and open questions.
assertions: Provenance with file key and node ID is at the top
Missing states are flagged as open questions
Hardcoded values are listed separately from tokens
